```
export function interpolateArcRotateCamera(camera, scene, goal, signal, options) {
  const start = { alpha: camera.alpha, beta: camera.beta, radius: camera.radius, target: new Vec3().copyFrom(camera.target) };
  const factor = options?.interpolationFactor ?? 0.1;
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    scene.onFrame(() => {
      if (goal.alpha !== undefined) camera.alpha = lerp(start.alpha, goal.alpha, factor);
      if (goal.beta !== undefined) camera.beta = lerp(start.beta, goal.beta, factor);
      if (goal.radius !== undefined) camera.radius = lerp(start.radius, goal.radius, factor);
      if (goal.target) camera.target.copyFrom(lerp(start.target, goal.target, factor));
      if (done) resolve();
    });
  });
}
```
